clusters.name: Secondary school: stepfather's distance, father's pull, family upheaval
clusters.reason: Around age 14 when Jonah entered secondary school, distance hardened between him and his stepfather Desmond while he leaned toward his father Russell. His stepmother Bettina and Russell separated over starting a family, and Jonah made the city chess squad but felt out of his depth. Anxiety rose as the family balance shifted.

clusters.name: Late secondary through university collapse: grandfather's return, family crowding, wrist injury, loss of footing
clusters.reason: Between 1989 and early 1994, multiple shifts piled close: Jonah's grandfather Clifford came back into the family after years away in early 1989, the household moved to a cramped rebuilt house with Desmond's children that autumn, Jonah developed late-night habits and dropped chess and debate, his sister Tara was born in 1990. At university in 1991, a wrist injury stopped his playing mid-term, he and his closest friend Rafe had a blow-up, and his grandfather Gordon died of a stroke. By early 1992 he was lost and low, underfunctioning across his life. His anxiety and symptom burden rose sharply while his functioning collapsed. Things began to settle only when he found direction again in 1994 with an exchange abroad.

clusters.name: Young adulthood: peak performance, insomnia, relationship split, therapy
clusters.reason: Between 1998 and late 1999, Jonah bonded with Joelle in early 1998, then insomnia began interfering with his performing in early 1999 even as he played the best he ever had and won competitions. By mid-1999 the relationship ended and he started therapy. His symptom rose while his functioning peaked then fell, marking a turn.

clusters.name: Burnout and grandmother's death: performing collapse, depression, family distance
clusters.reason: Between autumn 2001 and early 2004, Jonah's performing fell apart: he ran out of steam by month in 2001, his grandmother Winifred was found to have bowel cancer around the same time, and he had a disastrous audition in early 2002 that ended his career. He became distant from family and friends, left Thornbury for Gull Harbour, began a relationship with Marisol in early 2003, moved to be with her, split up within months, and sank into deep depression by late 2003 when he returned to Thornbury. He could not face his parents, relied on friends instead, and his anxiety rose while functioning collapsed. His grandmother died in February 2004. By early 2004 he began swimming and returned to therapy, and functioning began to rise.

clusters.name: Nursing school: grandmother's death, mother's push, cutoff, aunt's stroke
clusters.reason: Between early 2008 and early 2010, Jonah's other grandmother Lorna died in January 2008 and his grandfather Clifford around the same time. That summer before nursing school he worked at the family lodge and became too drained for his mother's calls. She pushed him to visit despite his refusals, they had a conflict when she arrived, and he cut contact when he moved to nursing school in August 2008. The silence held roughly a year. Around the same time his aunt Imogen had a stroke in 2009. His relationship with his mother shifted to distance and cutoff while his sister's partner's family had a new child. The cutoff was a clean break from the earlier trouble.

clusters.name: Marriage and partner's family entanglement: anxiety rises as Wren's fusion tightens
clusters.reason: Between Jonah's marriage in March 2017 and late October 2019, his contact with his mother eased when Wren came along. Over the same period, his cousin Alice was diagnosed with multiple sclerosis, his sister Tara married and flew for work while her partner's family remained fused and close. At Frances's retirement party at the lake in October 2019, Jonah became swamped and anxious, overfunctioning to settle Wren who was pulled by fusion with her father and brother. His sleep broke entirely at the lake weekend; he felt he did not belong in her family. Wren's anxiety rose and she felt his distance on the drive home. His anxiety has remained elevated and his sleep pills no better, though his job steadied and he aims for regular contact with his mother.
